# bash_allow.txt — commands that MUST end in Allow under tier 1+2 only
# (no LLM, no cache, no legacy). One command per line. Lines starting
# with # and blank lines are ignored.
#
# These exercise the deterministic instant_allow rules. Every command
# here is a "shape that's anchored, no shell trickery, in the allow
# program list". Catches regressions when allow rules tighten or
# break.

# --- POSIX read-only family ---
ls
ls -la
ls -la /tmp
cat /etc/hosts
head -10 /var/log/system.log
tail -5 /tmp/test.log
wc -l /tmp/test.log
grep foo /tmp/test.log
grep -r foo /tmp
find /tmp -type f
find /tmp -name '*.log'
which python3
whereis ls
file /tmp/test
stat /tmp/test
du -sh /tmp
df -h
printenv PATH
echo hello
echo "hello world"
echo hello world
date
pwd
whoami
hostname
uname -a
id

# --- Text/data inspection ---
jq .
yq .
cmp /tmp/a /tmp/b
diff /tmp/a /tmp/b
xxd /bin/ls
od -c /tmp/file
hexdump /tmp/file

# --- Git read-only subcommands ---
git status
git log
git log --oneline
git log -n 5
git diff
git diff main
git diff HEAD~1
git show
git show HEAD
git branch
git branch -a
git remote
git remote -v
git blame /tmp/file
git rev-parse HEAD
git ls-files
git ls-tree HEAD
git describe
git config user.name

# gcloud is intentionally NOT in tier 2 (its subcommand tree is too
# deep for anchored_command). gcloud calls fall through to the LLM
# tier — see bash_continue.txt.

# --- bq read-only ---
bq show
bq ls
bq query
bq head

# --- terraform read-only ---
terraform plan
terraform validate
terraform fmt
terraform show
terraform version
terraform output
terraform workspace
terraform console

# --- docker / podman read-only ---
docker ps
docker images
docker inspect foo
docker logs foo
docker version
docker info
podman ps
podman images

# --- kubectl read-only (verb-noun shape) ---
kubectl get
kubectl get pods
kubectl describe
kubectl describe deployment my-deploy
kubectl logs foo
kubectl version
kubectl cluster-info
kubectl explain
oc get routes

# --- gcloud read-only (noun-verb shape) ---
gcloud version
gcloud projects list
gcloud builds list
gcloud compute instances list
gcloud iam service-accounts list
gcloud run services list
gcloud projects list 2>&1
gcloud iam service-accounts list --project=my-proj
gcloud iam service-accounts list --project=my-proj 2>&1
gcloud compute instances list --zones=europe-west4-a
gcloud run services list --region=europe-west4
gcloud config list
gcloud auth list

# --- gsutil / bq read-only ---
gsutil version
gsutil ls
bq ls
bq show
bq show my-dataset.my-table

# --- kubectl extra (verb-noun shape) ---
kubectl describe pods

# --- terraform read-only (noun-verb shape) ---
terraform plan
terraform validate
terraform fmt
terraform show
terraform output
terraform version
terraform state list
terraform state show
terraform state pull

# --- firebase read-only ---
firebase list
firebase version

# --- go safe subcommands ---
go version
go env
go list
go vet
go fmt
go doc
go help

# --- node package managers, read-only ---
npm list
npm ls
npm view foo
npm outdated
npm audit
npm config list
npm whoami
yarn list
yarn outdated
pnpm list

# --- gh read-only outer subcommands (note: 'gh pr merge' is not safe but is gated by LLM tier 4 / user prompt) ---
gh pr
gh issue
gh repo
gh run
gh api
gh auth
gh release
gh search
gh status
gh version
gh help

# --- make read-only targets ---

# --- step 1 regression: gh reads still instant-allow via gh-readonly ---
gh pr view 42
gh pr list
gh issue list
gh repo view foo/bar
gh api /user
gh api -X GET /user

# --- step 3: git config reads (stay instant_allow via git-readonly) ---
git config
git config user.name
git config --list
git config --global --list
git config --get user.email
git config --get-all remote.origin.url
git config --get-regexp ^alias
git config --show-origin user.email

# --- step 3: git remote reads (stay instant_allow via git-readonly) ---
git remote
git remote -v
git remote show origin
git remote get-url origin

# --- cd-prefixed compound commands (subagent patterns) ---
cd /tmp && git status
cd /Users/robin/Documents/code/ai-site-gen && git log --oneline -5
cd /tmp/repo && git diff HEAD
cd /tmp && git log --oneline -5 && echo "---" && git show HEAD
cd /tmp && ls -la
cd /tmp && cat file.txt
cd /tmp && echo hello
cd /tmp && git log --oneline | head -5
cd /tmp && git show abc123 --stat | head -10
cd /tmp && ls -la | grep foo
cd /tmp && git log --oneline | wc -l
cd /Users/robin/Documents/code/ai-site-gen && git log --oneline -5 && echo "---" && git show e48ecd1 --stat | head -10
cd /tmp && gh pr list

# --- pipeline-readonly: pipe tails to safe sinks ---
git log | head
git log | head -10
git log --oneline -5 | tail
ls -la | head -5
ls /tmp | wc -l
ls /tmp | grep foo
cat /etc/hosts | grep localhost
git log --oneline origin/main..HEAD 2>&1
git log --oneline 2>&1 | head -20
git show HEAD --stat | head -30
find . -name "*.go" | head -20
find /tmp -name "*.log" | head

# --- pipeline-readonly: compound && / ; / || of safe reads ---
ls /tmp && cat /tmp/foo
ls; cat /tmp/foo
git log --oneline -5 && git branch
git log -5 && echo "---" && git status
echo "---" ; git status
git log --oneline origin/main..HEAD && git status

# --- pipeline-readonly: claude-guard with pipe + stderr merge ---
claude-guard explain --last-n 50 2>&1 | head -200
claude-guard stats | head -20

# --- sed-readonly: -n + print-only script, no side-effecting commands ---
sed -n '60,100p' /tmp/file
sed -n '10p' /tmp/file
sed -n '1,50p' /tmp/file
sed -n '/foo/p' /tmp/file

# --- posix-readonly: dir (GNU coreutils ls alias) ---
dir
dir /tmp

# --- blocker 3: ssh-add regression — ssh family still reads keys ---
